items.title: 67460_Sammy Price oral history interview
items.q: One time my mother...Mamie Smith had made 'The Crazy Blues.'

ctx.x: Yeah, Ma Rainey and Bert Williams. Incidentally.....let me tell you a story. One time my mother...Mamie Smith had made "The Crazy Blues." It was a very, very popular thing. So they said...wanted me to go and buy "The Crazy Blues." Now, instead of my going to the black store to buy it, I went to the white store to buy it. And I asked for "The Crazy Blues." The guy gave me

this "Crazy Blues" in a package and I went home and they said, "now if you break this I'm not going to exchange it." you know. So I walked very carefully and then I got home and they had a Gramophone, and my mother wound this thing up and put a needle in and put this "Crazy Blues" on and they thought that they were going to hear Mamie Smith and out came Bert Williams singing "The Crazy Blues." (Laughter)
